name: Ninh Binh food guide
summary: Ninh Bình eats goat and cơm cháy on the roads toward the karst, Kim Sơn noodles on the coast, and the doors the province printed in June 2025. Nam Định’s phở stays in Nam Định.
body: Eat the valley and the Kim Sơn coast as their own list. Cơm cháy is the plate with a photograph. The other dishes are names from the 15 February 2023 culture page and the 5 November 2024 tourism article. They print under the photograph as text until a licensed plate of that dish exists.

The doors are the provincial restaurant list dated 30 June 2025. The first heading is cơm văn phòng. The second heading is nhà hàng du lịch. The list does not call a room fine dining, and it does not describe a foreign menu. Hours were not printed. Check on arrival. A price appears only where that row prints one.
specialtiesLead: Cơm cháy is the dish with a photograph. The other names follow under their own heading, with the area the source gives.

sections.heading: Named dishes
paragraphs: These are the dishes named on the 15 February 2023 culture page and the 5 November 2024 tourism article, apart from cơm cháy above. Yên Khánh is described only as các loại bánh, with no cake named, so it is not a line here. A shop hour was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: De tai chanh
spots.address: Roads toward Tràng An, Hoa Lư, and Bái Đính
spots.note: Dê tái chanh is the goat plate the 15 February 2023 culture page puts with lá sung and nước tương. The page says mountain goat is firm because the animals climb the limestone. A shop hour was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: De xao sa ot
spots.address: Roads toward Tràng An, Hoa Lư, and Bái Đính
spots.note: Dê xào sả ớt is stir-fried mountain goat with lemongrass and chili, one of the preparations on the 15 February 2023 culture page. A shop hour was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: De nui nhung me
spots.address: Roads toward Tràng An, Hoa Lư, and Bái Đính
spots.note: Dê núi nhúng mẻ is mountain goat dipped in fermented rice, named on the 15 February 2023 culture page beside the other dê núi plates. A shop hour was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: De nuong ngu vi
spots.address: Roads toward Tràng An, Hoa Lư, and Bái Đính
spots.note: Dê nướng ngũ vị is five-spice grilled mountain goat, listed on the 15 February 2023 culture page. A shop hour was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: De ham thuoc bac
spots.address: Roads toward Tràng An, Hoa Lư, and Bái Đính
spots.note: Dê hầm thuốc bắc is mountain goat stewed with Chinese medicinal herbs, named on the 15 February 2023 culture page. A shop hour was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Doi de chien
spots.address: Roads toward Tràng An, Hoa Lư, and Bái Đính
spots.note: Dồi dê chiên is fried goat sausage, one of the dê núi dishes on the 15 February 2023 culture page. A shop hour was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Com chay sot de
spots.address: Roads toward Tràng An, Hoa Lư, and Bái Đính
spots.note: Cơm cháy sốt dê is the crisp rice cake with goat sauce. The 15 February 2023 culture page names it both as a way to eat cơm cháy and as one of the dê núi dishes. A shop hour was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Chao thit de
spots.address: Roads toward Tràng An, Hoa Lư, and Bái Đính
spots.note: Cháo thịt dê is goat-meat rice porridge, listed with the other mountain-goat dishes on the 15 February 2023 culture page. A shop hour was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: De u trau
spots.address: Roads toward Tràng An, Hoa Lư, and Bái Đính
spots.note: Dê ủ trấu is goat cooked in rice husks, named on the 15 February 2023 culture page with the other dê núi dishes. A shop hour was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Ca ri de
spots.address: Roads toward Tràng An, Hoa Lư, and Bái Đính
spots.note: Cà ri dê is goat curry, the last of the mountain-goat dishes named on the 15 February 2023 culture page. A shop hour was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Goi ca nhech
spots.address: Kim Sơn
spots.note: Gỏi cá nhệch is the Kim Sơn fish salad on the 15 February 2023 culture list. A 5 November 2024 tourism article also names gỏi nhệch for Kim Sơn. A shop hour was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Bun moc Kim Son
spots.address: Kim Sơn
spots.note: Bún mọc Kim Sơn is noodles with pork balls. The 15 February 2023 culture page says the pork is leg meat, seasoned with nước mắm, pepper, and bột ngọt, spread on banana leaf, and boiled 7 to 10 minutes. The balls are about the size of a child’s fist. A shop hour was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Ca chuoi nuong
spots.address: Vân Long
spots.note: Cá chuối nướng is grilled fish the 15 February 2023 culture page ties to đầm Vân Long. It says the flesh is white, with peanuts and herbs, dipped in nước mắm. A shop hour was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Ca tre nuong
spots.address: Vân Long
spots.note: Cá trê nướng is grilled catfish. The conservation page names it among things that have drawn visitors to Vân Long. It is not the same sentence as cá chuối nướng. A shop hour was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Oc nui
spots.address: The limestone. The culture page says April through August
spots.note: Ốc núi đá are the limestone snails the 15 February 2023 culture page says live in rock crevices and eat forest leaves. It says the meat is thick from April through August. A shop hour was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Xoi trung kien
spots.address: Nho Quan, in February
spots.note: Xôi trứng kiến is sticky rice with brown-ant eggs. The 15 February 2023 culture page says Ninh Bình’s come from Nho Quan and the dish exists only in February. It says the eggs pop when chewed. A shop hour was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Nem chua Yen Mac
spots.address: Yên Mạc
spots.note: Nem chua Yên Mạc is fermented pork. The 15 February 2023 culture page names garlic, chili, lá đinh lăng, and roasted rice powder. A 2024 tourism article names the same plate for Yên Mô. A shop hour was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Bun cha quat
spots.address: Ninh Bình. A commune was not printed
spots.note: Bún chả quạt is noodles with a wide grilled pork patty. The 15 February 2023 culture page contrasts that patty with the round pieces elsewhere. A shop hour was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Mien luon
spots.address: Ninh Bình. A street was not printed
spots.note: Miến lươn on the 15 February 2023 Ninh Bình culture page is glass noodles in a broth simmered from eel bones, with eel cooked in seasoning. The page asks for small eels, brown-pink along the back. A shop hour was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Banh xeo with nem lui
spots.address: Ninh Bình. A street was not printed
spots.note: The 15 February 2023 culture page says bánh xèo is made in many provinces, and that the Ninh Bình plate is the crisp pancake with nem lụi and herbs. It does not claim the pancake was invented here. A shop hour was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Cua dong rang la lot
spots.address: Ninh Bình. A street was not printed
spots.note: Cua đồng rang lá lốt is field crab fried with betel leaf, named on the 15 February 2023 culture page. A shop hour was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Banh da ca ro dong
spots.address: Ninh Bình. A street was not printed
spots.note: Bánh đa cá rô đồng is a rice cracker with field climbing perch. The 15 February 2023 culture page says you eat it with green mustard greens. A shop hour was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Mam tep Gia Vien
spots.address: Gia Viễn
spots.note: Mắm tép Gia Viễn is shrimp paste from Gia Viễn, on the 15 February 2023 culture list. A 2024 tourism article names the same paste for Gia Viễn and a gift ranking for 2020–2021. A shop hour was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Ruou can Nho Quan
spots.address: Nho Quan
spots.note: Rượu cần Nho Quan is un-distilled jar wine of the Mường. The 15 February 2023 culture page says it is made from glutinous rice and yeast, and that you add a little water to the jar and drink. A shop hour was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Ruou Kim Son
spots.address: Kim Sơn
spots.note: Rượu Kim Sơn is the drink the tourism overview names with goat and cơm cháy. The culture page’s jar wine, rượu cần, is a different sentence. Do not treat them as one bottle. A shop hour was not printed. Check on arrival.
